nom: Kate Somerville EradiKate Acne Mark Fading Gel

avis.titre: Worst nightmare. Made my skin worse
avis.texte: This product gave me my worst nightmare. After using this product hoping to remove my pimple scars, it left my skin with red and dry patches and worst, it even broke me out. So the pimple marks turned into active pimples and I had the biggest pimple ever that turned into a deep wound after using this gel into those spots. Instead of fixing "small blemishes or pimple marks" it made my skin worse, and resulted to bigger marks. After one month, that big pimple which turned into a deep wound or had deep scarring is not yet fully healed. This product did not do anything to my blemishes and pimple marks, so its a complete waste of money. I even needed to spend more to address the big and red patches caused by this product especially that big pimple or deep wound/scarring. This product is sooooo terrible. Considering that it is pricey.

I adore Kate Somerville's products. I use her eradikate daily cleanser. I do think her products are worth the money, if you can afford it this bottle, however I feel wasn't filled up adequately because it was barely up to a month, and I had to open the top to see what was left and it was practically gone so for the money I would prefer it to last a little longer. I was hardly using it twice a day, but it was moisturizing on my skin and worked well with other products to prevent acne scarring. I would give it some more time though to see results.
This helped my acne and skin looks so much better! Once I added this to my routine, I hardly have any zits or pimples at all.
This stuff is incredible. I regularly have pore clogging issues despite my best efforts and this stuff works miracles overnight. Cannot express enough good things about this product!
So far so good, looks like it's diminishing my scars from previous breakouts. Very nice for my sensitive skin.

I have been using this product for about 4 weeks now. I have always suffered from hormonal acne and have some scarring. My skin now has genuinely never looked this amazing! Definitely will repurchase.

I was very hesitant into buying this product at first, but thankfully I did buy it. I used it faithfully everyday for about a month and the difference was amazing! I honestly used it once a day instead of twice but did notice a huge difference. I have always suffered from hormonal acne but this was a game changer.
I have bad scarring on my shoulders from an accident, my body rejected tiny shards of glass that mimicked acne for over a year&this faded them entirely. Did wonders for facial acne breakouts too.
This product lightened my scarring, but has not completely erased them. It causes my skin to break out, but it does clear up the spots/scars. I will continue to use until all is clear.
I added this product recently- I don't use it daily - but find its a great addition and my skin looks smoother and clearer since using.
Super lightweight. Doesn't dry out my skin & helps so much. Love the product but not the packaging. The silver paint chips & gets all over. Still will buy again
I really like this product, goes on smooth and doesn't make my skin feel tight or dry. For me, I think this works better on getting rid of acne better then the sulfur spot treatment!
I love all of their products but the acne mark fading gel is next level. It literally melts right into your skin and I am seeing results after 3 days of use (2x a day) followed by the recovery serum.

I've had inflammation acne for most of my life. It's due to a health condition, so there's not a lot I can do. I try my best though. I was excited that this said it would help fade scars. I used it faithfully for several weeks. I expected to have a purge, but this was the worst breakout I think I've ever had. It's been awful! I don't know that it faded scars. My skin has never been worse though.
I love this serum, but the silver paint on the pump flecks off into the product. I expect better of such high quality products from KS.

I was hesitant on purchasing this since there aren't any reviews. Once I used this product for a month or two and I've noticed a huge difference in my skin. I've always had bad hyperpigmentation for years and I've been way more confident. This has helped so much because I've had pigmentation for years and no matter how many topical creams they have never worked. I would recommend!
EradiKate serum has helped my acne and and cystic acne. Since using it 4 months ago I have not had 1 single breakout. This product line has been a game changer for me!
I have a tan/olive skin so I am very susceptible to getting dark spots. I use a little dab on each of my spots at night. Make sure to moisturize the next morning because it is very drying.
My skin is so clear and I no longer get breakout at all. By far my favorite acne product on the market.
Highly recommend. No longer gets breakouts. By far my favorite acne product.
Keeps my skin clear and goes on well Smell is a little off putting At first but I grows on you ;)

I have been using this product for about two weeks now, and I have started to see noticeable results. My acne scares on my chin have started to go away, and my skin looks healthier overall. I also have some rosacea on my cheeks, and this product calmed the redness down almost within a day or two. Will be re-ordering once I run out!
